Consumer use: [L2] states this criterion and step 1.1 applies it to the lines R*K_0 and R*H to certify them as Cartan subalgebras of sl_2(R). Interface: sufficient - the supplier is the definition invoked, and both lines are one-dimensional abelian, hence nilpotent, with normalizer computed in the step.
